name: Cone Setter
subtitle: AR + LiDAR cone layouts for Formula Student test days
description: Sideload source for Cone Setter, an iPhone app that uses ARKit and the LiDAR scanner to show where every cone of a Formula Student / FS-AI skidpad, acceleration or autocross layout goes.

apps.name: Cone Setter
apps.subtitle: Place FS track cones with AR + LiDAR
apps.localizedDescription:
Lay out Formula Student / FS-AI test tracks with your iPhone Pro.

• Skidpad and acceleration layouts generated from FS dimensions (editable), plus CSV import for autocross / trackdrive
• Tap two taped reference marks (A and B) to align the layout to the ground
• A ghost cone, distance, direction arrow and centimetre offset guide you to each spot, with haptics inside your tolerance
• Chain mode: every cone you mark becomes a reference for the cones after it, so tracking drift doesn't build up
• Mark a placed cone by aiming at its tip — no need to see under it
• Live fit RMS and red flags for cones out of tolerance
• Save sessions with the AR map and GPS site tag, export measured positions as CSV

Built for the iPhone 17 Pro Max (works on any LiDAR iPhone running iOS 18+).
